title: Screening-kernel realization of the simple W(2,2) vertex algebra inside the level-zero twisted Heisenberg-Virasoro vertex algebra for cLI nonzero and cW = -24 cLI squared
author: Drazen Adamovic; Gordan Radobolja
work: On Free Field Realizations of W(2,2)-Modules
source_version: Official SIGMA 12 (2016) article 113, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2016.113; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a nonsemisimple Jordan highest-weight extension and a screening field with explicit commutator relations. Identifying the entire kernel requires the author-proved atypical branching and contragredient module structure, rather than merely checking that the two vertex generators are killed.

source_check.note: The complete original screening/derivation and kernel Theorem 4.3 is retained as one main problem unit, with the full new Jordan-module/square-zero-extension screening construction and all author atypical branching/contragredient core needed to identify the entire kernel. The selected kernel domain is the simple level-zero Heisenberg–Virasoro vacuum algebra; the zero mode is also a derivation of the explicitly constructed extended algebra. Earlier highest-weight classifications, the original embedding and the square-zero vertex-extension theorem remain cited prerequisites. No forthcoming intertwining/fusion construction or separate typical branching statement is counted. Existing approved human statement/proof/context/above-qualification decision copied from the frozen manifest and metadata; no new source or mathematical review.

proof_review.note: Complete Section4 construction and proof read, including the induced Jordan module quotient, square-zero vertex extension formula, screening commutators and its nonzero value on I(-1)1. The kernel equality uses the vacuum length-two W-module structure explicitly exhibited in Example3.9 on physical page10, supported by Theorem3.3, Lemma3.5 and Corollary3.6 on6-8. Earlier highest-weight classifications and the standard square-zero vertex-extension theorem are identified published background. No forthcoming fusion/intertwining constructions are selected. The kernel domain is the simple Heisenberg-Virasoro vacuum vertex algebra, not the whole extended vertex algebra.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem4.3: the zero mode S1 is a derivation of the explicitly constructed extended vertex algebra; its kernel restricted to the simple level-zero twisted Heisenberg-Virasoro vacuum algebra is precisely the embedded simple W(2,2) algebra. Complex cL is arbitrary, cLI is nonzero, Heisenberg central charge cI is zero and cW=-24 cLI squared.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: In Proposition4.2 the displayed W(0)v1=-2cLI v0 is immediately followed by W(n)v1=0 for n>=0. The latter index includes the separately specified nonzero zeroth action; the positive-mode reading is fixed by that same explicit display and the induced highest-weight construction. The original author bytes are retained without modification.
